title: IT Services Company Equity Stake For Sale in Selangor, Malaysia
tagline: The business specializes in professional data center cleaning and IT infrastructure services. - It serves more than 50 clients across government, financial services, telecommunications, and enterprise sectors. - The company employs 20 people across technical, operations, sales, marketing, and finance functions. - The business generates revenue through one-time and scheduled cleaning contracts. - It also earns income from IT maintenance, infrastructure upgrades, project-based engineering services, and the supply and installation of technical products. - Smart rack systems are available for both purchase and rental, creating additional revenue opportunities. - The business has established relationships with major organizations and operates with trained technical personnel and specialized cleaning equipment. - Its capabilities include airborne particle testing, environmental assessments, and technical testing and commissioning. - The business has received recognition through the SME100 Award, the Golden Bull Award, and the South East Asia Business Awards. - It is wholly Bumiputera-owned and has an established operating presence in Malaysia. - The high monthly revenue can be attributed to the business's specialized data center cleaning contracts, IT infrastructure projects, and supply and installation of technical equipment. With 20 employees, the company serves more than 50 clients and generates revenue through both recurring service contracts and high-value project-based engagements. Its use of specialized equipment and established operational processes enables the team to handle multiple projects efficiently without requiring a large workforce. - The business has a business registration certificate.
